# Automated Cryptanalysis of Classical Ciphers

**[Download the single Python file](https://github.com/Karthiksidduu/Shelby/raw/cursor/cipher-cryptanalysis-6509/cipher_cryptanalysis.py)**

Save `cipher_cryptanalysis.py`, then run `python cipher_cryptanalysis.py`. That one file is the whole project: Caesar encrypt and decrypt, the 25-key search, chi-squared ranking, the substitution hill climber, the lecture screens, the text report, and the accuracy experiment.
